title: Plank progression for beginners: from the wall to the floor in 5 rungs
caption: Plank progression for beginners: five rungs from a plank on the wall to shoulder taps on the floor, each with the test that says you are ready for the next. Wall Plank, Incline Plank, Knee Plank, Full Plank, then Plank Shoulder Tap at the top. Save the ladder.

overlays.text: Week one: a plank on the wall. Week eight: a plank on the floor.
Wall Plank. 20 seconds. Hands on the wall, walk your feet back, body in one line.

scenes.footer: Ready when your hips stay level the whole 20 seconds.

overlays.text: Incline Plank. 20 seconds. Hands on a chair against the wall, body straight, hold.
Knee Plank. 25 seconds. Forearms and knees down, hips in line, hold.
Full Plank. 30 seconds. On your forearms and toes, body long, keep breathing.

scenes.footer: Ready when your hips stay still on every tap.

overlays.text: Plank Shoulder Tap. 10 reps. Up on your hands, tap one shoulder, then the other.

scenes.footer: Wrists tired? Stay on the forearm rungs.

overlays.text: The wall, chair and shoulder-tap rungs load your wrists. The forearm rungs do not.
